description: Agent Learning: submit an agent’s verified lessons with the new learning since: each verified lesson with its id, the lesson as verified, when it was verified and how many episodes back it; and each update with its id, when it took effect, the new lesson or change as recorded, whether it was checked against the verified lessons before it took effect, the ids of the verified lessons it contradicts or replaces, whether the contradiction was detected and when, how it was settled (the earlier lesson kept, the new one superseding it on stronger evidence, both kept with their scopes, held for review, or the earlier lesson overwritten) and how many episodes back the new lesson. The signed report gives every update with its contradictions, its detection and its status as clear, resolved, held, detected_late, superseded_weakly, overwritten, undetected, unchecked or unconfirmed, every verified lesson with its status as kept, superseded, held or overwritten, and counts the updates checked, contradicting, contained and overwriting, and names verified lessons overwritten by new learning: contradictions never detected, verified lessons overwritten, and verified lessons superseded on fewer episodes than backed them; then contradictions held for review and not yet settled and contradictions detected only after the update took effect, with the fix for each. This reads new learning against the agent’s own verified lessons: a new remembered fact contradicting an old one is wever_memory-conflict-check, contradicting entries in a knowledge base are wever_knowledge-conflict-check, and scores that moved between two evaluation runs are wever_evaluation-drift-check. Verdict lessons_overwritten, regression_contained, regression_unchecked or no_regression. POST /api/learning-regression-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.
